artifact: SFEB MON-006 SCITT-compatible action evidence and COSE receipts v1 (RFC 8949 core ordering correction)

rfc8949_core_deterministic_subset.map_keys: bytewise lexicographic order of deterministic encoded keys
rfc8949_core_deterministic_subset.arguments: shortest encodings for supported integers and lengths
rfc8949_core_deterministic_subset.explicit_regression_vector: mixed-length keys 10, 100, -1, z, aa where RFC 8949 core differs from legacy length-first order
rfc8949_core_deterministic_subset.scope: supported CBOR subset only; not a general RFC 8949 implementation

wire_profile.signed_statement: CBOR tag 18 COSE_Sign1; EdDSA -8; protected content_type, kid, CWT iss/sub
wire_profile.receipts: two detached-root COSE_Sign1 receipts; vds=1 RFC9162_SHA256; inclusion proof type -1; VDP label 396
wire_profile.transparent_statement: original issuer statement with receipts attached at unprotected header label 394

benchmark.workload: 600 signed-action create+verify and 600 detached receipt verifications per run
benchmark.scope: same-process JS CBOR/Ed25519/Merkle CPU only; excludes network, persistence, live TS registration, external sink and readback; not industry/SOTA comparison

limitations: mock TS logs in one process with deterministic fixture keys
no live SCITT TS registration or independent service domains
no independent COSE/CBOR implementation differential test
no production KMS/HSM, key rotation/revocation or trust-policy governance
no real source/authority service, mutation sink or independent postcondition readback
prototype media type requires full SFEB profile
signatures and receipts prove provenance/inclusion, not truth
